/service-areas/: Find Temporary123 rental service areas across the United States. Select a state on the map, then open its regional or city guides for equipment-specific rental planning. Confirm availability and delivery arrangements for your exact site and dates.
/services/: Explore temporary facility rental services for commercial and institutional operations. Select a service below to review its own equipment and requirements, from commercial cooking and warewashing to cold storage, hygiene and crew accommodation. Different product types are identified separately.
/equipment-rental/: Compare Temporary123 equipment rental options by its named product type and configuration. The directory separates kitchen trailers, cold storage, hygiene facilities, accommodation and site-support equipment. Review the photograph or labelled layout for each entry, then confirm the actual available unit, utilities and delivery requirements.
/industries/: Match temporary facility rentals to the operation you need to maintain. Explore construction and workforce projects, food service and hospitality, government services or emergency response, then review the equipment and site requirements relevant to that setting.
/equipment-rental/mobile-kitchen-trailer: Plan commercial kitchen trailer rental around the food you prepare and the service you need to maintain. Compare cooking and preparation layouts, then confirm appliance requirements, power, potable water, drainage, ventilation clearance and trailer access for the available unit.
/portable-dishwashing-trailer-rental/: Rent dedicated dishwashing trailer capacity for serviceware, utensils and kitchen equipment. Match the wash process and rack throughput to your operation, then confirm loading space, water temperature, power, drainage and trailer placement.
/equipment-rental/refrigeration/: Plan refrigerated trailer rental around the supplies you store, required temperatures and loading schedule. Confirm usable storage volume, electrical supply and trailer access. The separately labelled 20 ft container option uses an approved shared interior reference; no container exterior is pictured.
/equipment-rental/shower-trailer/: Plan emergency shower trailer rental around the number of users, peak washing times and hot-water demand. Confirm the available shower-only configuration, water supply, wastewater servicing and delivery access. A shower container is a separate delivery option, not the same unit as the trailer.
/equipment-rental/restroom-trailers/: Plan restroom-only trailer rental for temporary toilet and handwashing access. Confirm stall count, accessible arrangements, privacy, water supply and wastewater servicing for the available unit. Shower/restroom combination options are separate products and do not establish a restroom-only configuration.
/equipment-rental/mobile-sleep-trailers/: Plan rental of sleeper and bunk-bed facilities around crew occupancy, shift patterns and privacy requirements. Review the identified sleeping-room references and confirm bed layout, ventilation, utilities, overall dimensions and delivery configuration before selecting an available unit.
/equipment-rental/laundry-trailers/: Plan laundry trailer rental around workwear volume, crew size and the washing schedule. Review trailer-based washing and drying capacity, then confirm machine layout, power, water, drainage and service access. Container-based laundry is a different product type.
/equipment-rental/handwashing-stations/: Plan portable handwashing trailer rental for convenient washing access at temporary work areas. Review the identified sink-trailer views and confirm sink access, water supply, drainage, expected users and servicing. Hands-free operation must be confirmed for the actual unit.
/services/shower-restroom-combination-tr: Compare rental options for shower and restroom combination trailers that provide washing and toilet facilities in the same product. Review the named stall configurations separately and confirm privacy, water heating, wastewater servicing, available floor plans and any required accessible arrangements.
/food-services-2/: Lease a kitchen trailer to maintain food preparation and cooking during a renovation, interruption or temporary food-service operation. Plan the cooking line around your menu and meal volume, then confirm preparation space, food storage, utilities, ventilation and delivery access. The gallery shows identified kitchen equipment references.
/man-camps-for-rent/: Plan construction trailer rentals and base-camp facilities around the crew's working day. Define accommodation, meal preparation, hygiene, office and utility requirements separately, then coordinate the camp layout and delivery sequence. Confirm each available product and its capacity rather than treating different facilities as one unit.
/government/: Plan government temporary facility rentals around the public service that must continue during maintenance, field work or an interruption. Specify the required working space, food-service, hygiene or accommodation functions, together with access controls and utility requirements. Confirm procurement documents and the available equipment for the actual project.
/disaster-relief-man-camp-workforce-rent: Plan emergency-response trailer rental around the facilities your response team needs first. Identify the required working, sleeping, food-service or hygiene functions, site access and known utilities. The rental team must confirm available equipment, setup responsibilities and dispatch timing for the conditions you report.
/26ft-military-bulk-kitchen/: Review the 26ft Military Bulk Kitchen reference for temporary high-volume food preparation. Match the proposed cooking workflow to the menu, meal periods and service volume, then confirm the actual unit length, appliance specification, utilities and transport requirements. Photographs of other kitchen sizes do not establish this model.
/40ft-military-bulk-kitchen/: Review the 40ft Military Bulk Kitchen option for bulk meal preparation in a temporary feeding operation. Confirm the actual cooking line, batch-production equipment, preparation space, utilities and delivery footprint against your menu and meal volume. Reference images do not establish current availability or a military specification.
/2800-correctional-facilities-series/: Review the 2800 Correctional Facilities Series as a modular workspace option for a correctional-site project. Define staff activities, occupancy, access controls and the required room arrangement, then confirm the actual building specification, installation requirements and facility approvals with the project team.
/2800-military-series/: Review the 2800 Military Series modular workspace reference for an operational project. Specify working areas, staffing, communications, power and access requirements, then confirm the actual layout and installation scope. The series name and imagery do not establish a particular mission capability or approval.
/4000-correctional-facilities-series/: Review the 4000 Correctional Facilities Series reference for a correctional-site space requirement. Confirm the actual modular layout, intended staff activities, occupancy, utilities and controlled access before planning installation. This page does not establish security performance or project approval.
/4000-military-series/: Review the 4000 Military Series modular workspace option against your operational brief. Define staff functions, room arrangement, communications, utilities and delivery constraints, then confirm the actual configuration and installation scope with the project team.
/4500-correctional-facilities-series/: Review the 4500 Correctional Facilities Series for the temporary space your correctional operation requires. Discuss staff workflow, occupancy, controlled access and utilities, and confirm the actual modular configuration and applicable facility requirements before booking.
/4500-military-series/: Review the 4500 Military Series workspace reference for field coordination and operational planning. Confirm the room arrangement, staff capacity, communications provisions, power and site access for the actual unit. The series label alone does not establish performance or mission readiness.
/base-camps-for-rent/: Plan a rented base camp with modular housing and supporting facilities sized to the workforce. Identify sleeping occupancy, meal periods, hygiene requirements and the project phases, then confirm each unit's layout, utilities, delivery method and servicing responsibilities.
/camp-management-and-design/: Plan camp management and design around how the workforce will live and operate on site. Map accommodation, meals, hygiene, circulation and servicing, then define management responsibilities, utility requirements and delivery phases for the proposed camp.
/construction-man-camp-rentals/: Plan construction man-camp rental around peak crew numbers, shift changes and the duration of the build. Coordinate sleeping accommodation, meals and hygiene without obstructing construction traffic, then confirm each facility, utility connection and servicing responsibility for the actual job site.
/facility-management-and-base-operations: Define facility management and base-operations support around the functions your site needs to maintain. Agree responsibility for accommodation services, maintenance, utilities, supplies and daily coordination, together with staffing, schedules and the scope of the proposed service agreement.
/government-and-non-government/: Review the government and non-government approval information presented for Temporary123. Check the current documents, issuing organization, validity and scope for your specific procurement or project; a listed approval should not be assumed to cover every facility or service.
/government/correctional-facilities/: Plan temporary space for correctional-facility operations, staff activities or renovation continuity. Specify the intended use, occupancy, controlled access, utilities and site constraints, then confirm the actual modular layout and applicable facility requirements. Equipment imagery does not establish security performance.
/government/hospitals/: Plan temporary facilities around the hospital function that must remain available during maintenance or disruption. Identify the required space, users, access, utilities and operating constraints, then confirm the actual equipment and project requirements. No clinical capability or healthcare approval is established by the images alone.
/government/military-kitchen/: Plan a military-kitchen project around the feeding requirement, menu and peak meal periods. Review cooking, preparation and food-storage space, then confirm the actual appliance line, utilities, transport and project-specific requirements. Equipment selection and any required approvals must be confirmed for the proposed installation.
/gsa-schedule/: Review the published GSA Schedule and supplier-document information for Temporary123. Confirm current contract details, the eligible purchasing route, available services and requirements with the rental team before relying on them for a procurement.
/hospitality/: Discuss hospitality support for a temporary or remote workforce location. Define the required food service, housekeeping, accommodation and daily support functions, then confirm staffing, site resources, service responsibilities and the scope available for your project.
/man-camp-rental/: Plan man-camp rental for crews working at remote job sites. Match sleeping accommodation to occupancy and shift patterns, then coordinate the required food-service, hygiene and utility facilities. Confirm each product's layout, transport method and servicing plan for the site and rental period.
/mining-man-camp-rentals/: Plan mining man-camp rentals around crew rotations, occupancy and the phases of the mining project. Coordinate accommodation and the required meal, hygiene and utility functions, then review transport access, installation space and servicing responsibilities for the actual site.
/mobile-kitchen-trailer-rental/: Rent a mobile kitchen trailer to maintain commercial food preparation and cooking while permanent facilities are unavailable. Match the cooking line and preparation space to your menu, meal volume and service schedule, then confirm utilities, ventilation, delivery access and the available trailer configuration.
/mobile-man-camp-for-lease/: Plan a mobile man-camp lease around workforce occupancy, project duration and any anticipated relocation. Coordinate sleeping accommodation with the required food-service, hygiene and utility facilities, then confirm delivery, setup, servicing and lease responsibilities for each product.
/mobile-staffing/: Discuss mobile staffing against the specific roles, skills and work schedule your project needs. Provide the location, assignment duration, supervision arrangements and required qualifications, then confirm personnel availability and responsibilities. Certifications and deployment arrangements must be checked for the actual assignment.
/mobile-units-for-disaster-relief-specia: Plan mobile accommodation and support units for disaster-relief teams or special-event operations. Specify the number of users, shift or event schedule, access conditions and utilities, then confirm the available unit's sleeping layout, servicing needs and delivery timing rather than assuming a particular bed capacity.
/modular-kitchen-facilities/: Plan modular kitchen facilities for temporary cooking and food preparation in a building-based layout. Define the menu, production workflow, footprint and appliance requirements, then confirm installation, utilities, access and the actual modular configuration. Kitchen trailers are a separate form factor.
/oilfield-man-camp-rentals/: Plan oilfield man-camp rentals around crew rotations and the duration of drilling, pipeline or support work. Coordinate sleeping accommodation, meals, hygiene and utilities, then confirm access, placement, servicing and the facilities available for the actual project.
/portable-man-camps-for-rent/: Compare portable man-camp rental options for temporary workforce housing. Define crew occupancy, shift patterns and the required support functions, then confirm transport method, setup space, utilities and servicing for each accommodation and facility unit.
/remote-basecamp-temporary-housing-rent-: Plan remote-basecamp temporary housing rentals with clearly identified mobile trailers and modular-building options. Match accommodation, washing, laundry and dining requirements to the crew and operating schedule, then confirm each product's layout, delivery method, utilities and servicing for the actual site.
/remote-man-camp-for-rent/: Plan a remote man camp for rent around the workforce that will stay on site. Separate sleeping, meal, washing and daily support needs, then review transport access, available utilities and servicing responsibilities before selecting the actual camp facilities.
/remote-man-camp-rental/: Plan remote man-camp rental for the occupancy and working pattern of your job site. Coordinate accommodation with essential food-service, hygiene and utility functions, then confirm the equipment layout, transport, setup and ongoing servicing requirements.
/restroom-trailer-rental/: Plan restroom trailer rental for temporary toilet and handwashing access. Match the actual restroom-only configuration to expected users, privacy and accessibility requirements, then confirm water, wastewater and servicing. Shower/restroom combination imagery is not evidence of a restroom-only unit.
/shower-trailer-rental/: Plan shower trailer rental for private washing access at a temporary site or during permanent washroom downtime. Review peak use, hot-water demand, water supply, drainage and servicing, and confirm the available shower-only stall layout separately from combination units or containers.
/sleeper-trailer-rental/: Plan sleeper trailer rental around the crew's sleeping occupancy, shifts and privacy needs. Review the identified bunk-room references and confirm the actual bed layout, ventilation, utilities, trailer dimensions and placement requirements. Do not infer an unlisted chassis or capacity from an interior photograph.
/temporary-man-camp-solutions/: Compare temporary man-camp solutions for portable workforce housing and daily site support. Define occupancy, sleeping arrangements, meals and hygiene requirements, then confirm each product, utility connection, transport method and service responsibility for the proposed camp.
/turnkey-man-camp-solutions/: Define a turnkey man-camp proposal around the workforce housing and support functions your project requires. Confirm which accommodation, meal, hygiene, utility, installation and management services are included, and agree delivery phases and responsibilities before booking. Turnkey scope must be confirmed for the actual project.
/video/: View the Temporary123 equipment video and image references available on this page. Match each example to its labelled facility type, then confirm the actual model, configuration and availability with the rental team; a media example does not establish a completed deployment at your location.
/equipment-rental/classroom-trailers/: Plan classroom trailer rental around the teaching or training program, class size and seating arrangement. The displayed drawing is a classroom layout reference, not a photograph. Confirm the actual room dimensions, access, power, ventilation and delivery requirements before selecting a unit.
/equipment-rental/mobile-office-trailers: Plan mobile office trailer rental for on-site desk work and coordination. Review the office reference and confirm workstation layout, occupancy, communications, power, ventilation and delivery access for the actual unit.
/equipment-rental/modular-command-center: Plan command-center trailer rental around the coordination team, working areas and communications requirements. Review the labelled layout reference, then confirm the actual room arrangement, equipment, utilities and delivery footprint. The image does not establish mission capability or installed communications systems.
/equipment-rental/mobile-crew-camps/: Plan mobile crew-camp rental around occupancy, shifts and project duration. The site-plan reference separates accommodation, meals, hygiene and supporting facilities rather than showing one combined unit. Confirm the actual products, camp footprint, utilities and servicing plan.
/equipment-rental/stair-rentals/: Plan stair rental for access to the selected temporary facility. Confirm the entry height, available landing space, expected users and installation requirements. A ramp photograph does not establish the required stair configuration; matching stair photography is pending.
/equipment-rental/security-camera-traile: Plan security-camera trailer rental around the areas you need to observe and the site operating schedule. Review placement, power, communications and monitoring responsibilities, then confirm the actual camera equipment and coverage with the supplier.
/equipment-rental/tent-structures/: Plan temporary tent rental around the intended operation, required covered area and site conditions. Review the interior reference and confirm footprint, installation access, anchoring, utilities and the requirements applicable to the actual location.
/equipment-rental/ramp-rentals/: Plan ramp rental around the facility entrance, change in level and users who need access. Review the ramp and deck reference, then confirm dimensions, available approach space, installation and suitability for the specific access requirement.
/equipment-rental/wastewater-and-freshwa: Plan rental of water-storage and wastewater containers around the volume and type of water your site must handle. The exterior tank reference does not establish potable-water or wastewater suitability. Confirm the selected tank, connections, placement, collection and servicing responsibilities.
/equipment-rental/modular-buildings/: Plan modular building rental around the activities, occupancy and space your operation needs. The image is a building-assembly reference, not a completed interior. Confirm the actual building system, room layout, utilities, transport and installation requirements.
/equipment-rental/bunkhouse-trailers/: Plan bunkhouse trailer rental around crew sleeping occupancy, shifts and privacy. Review the approved bunk-room interiors and confirm the actual bed layout, ventilation, utilities, dimensions and delivery configuration. A container interior is not proof of a trailer chassis.
/equipment-rental/fencing-barricades-tra: Plan rental of fencing, barricades and receptacles as separate site-control and waste-management items. The catalogue view shows barricades only. Confirm the specific products, boundaries, circulation routes, placement and servicing required for your site.
/equipment-rental/generator-trailers/: Plan generator trailer rental around the connected equipment, starting loads and operating hours. Review the towable-generator reference and confirm output, voltage, connection arrangements, fuel, placement and servicing for the actual unit.
/equipment-rental/dining-structure-renta: Plan dining-structure rental around seating, meal periods and movement between food service and the dining area. Confirm the covered space, furnishings, access and site requirements. Kitchen-fleet photographs are not dining-space photography; a matching image is pending.
/equipment-rental/breakroom-trailer/: Plan breakroom trailer rental around the number of people using the space during each break. The drawing is a layout reference, not a photograph. Confirm seating, counters, appliances, ventilation, utilities and the actual trailer dimensions.
/services/handwashing-trailers/hands-fre: Plan hands-free handwashing facilities around the required operating method, users and available water and drainage. Confirm the actual foot-operated or sensor-operated equipment with the rental team. Generic sink-trailer photographs do not verify hands-free operation.
